agents_model_binding_check.name: agents_model_binding_check
agents_model_binding_check.value:
("agents"."model_binding_state" = 'legacy' and "agents"."model_binding_mode" is null
      and "agents"."model_configuration_id" is null and "agents"."model_configuration_revision" is null)
    or ("agents"."model_binding_mode" = 'runtime_default'
      and "agents"."model_configuration_id" is null and "agents"."model_configuration_revision" is null)
    or ("agents"."model_binding_mode" = 'pinned'
      and "agents"."model_configuration_id" is not null and "agents"."model_configuration_revision" is not null)

episodic_memories_ownership_check.name: episodic_memories_ownership_check
episodic_memories_ownership_check.value: ("episodic_memories"."scope" = 'agent_private' AND "episodic_memories"."owner_agent_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("episodic_memories"."scope" = 'space_shared' AND "episodic_memories"."owner_agent_id" IS NULL)
